base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: endless grey corridors lined with identical filing drawers, labelled shelving, grey pipes and ventilation shafts. Lighting: flat grey fluorescent strip lights.
In the shot: Duggie, an enormous, lovable Golden Retriever with shining coin-gold fur smeared with bog mud and river silt, one blade of grass stuck to his head, extraordinarily long floppy ears that flap like wings, huge soulful golden-brown eyes, a giant wagging tail, and a small swarm of cartoon flies circling his head in tight synchronised formation; the Grumpy Glitch-Bots, boxy grey rectangular robots shaped like small filing cabinets on stubby metal legs, each with a small speaker grille for a mouth, a single blinking red sensor eye, and a chest panel covered in rows of grey buttons; they move stiffly in rigid formation.
Camera: Fast action, whip-pans following Duggie.
Action: Duggie ricochets off the walls and pounces on three Glitch-Bots with wet muddy paws, sending sparks flying.
No dialogue.
Sound effects: boings, metallic clangs, sparks, enormous slurp, power-down whine, ambience of humming fluorescents, typewriter clacks, servo whirs.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
